def get_next_open_row(board, col):

    return -1

def winning_move(board, piece):

            b_copy[row][col] = OPPONENT_PIECE
            new_score = minimax(b_copy, depth-1, alpha, beta, True)
            value = min(value, new_score)
            beta = min(beta, value)
            if alpha >= beta:
                break
        return value
